name: Dawat Restaurant @ Indus Lodges
area: River View Rd (riverfront, near Food Street)
must_try: Charcoal BBQ platter and grilled trout on the rooftop
pros: Rooftop terrace with direct Gilgit River and mountain views
Consistently rated the highest-scoring sit-down spot in the city
Fresh food, attentive service noted repeatedly in reviews
cons: Rooftop fills up fast at sunset/dinner rush
Pricier than the bazaar dhabbas
take: The current darling of Gilgit dining  -  go at sunset for the river view and order the BBQ or trout. Book ahead in peak season.

name: Gilgit Food Yard
area: River View Rd (alongside the Gilgit River)
cuisine: Local Gilgiti / Central Asian (Chapli kebab, Mantu, Laghman)
pros: River-side setting framed by mountains
Strong on local specialties like Mantu and Laghman, not just generic Pakistani fare
Reasonable prices for the quality and location
cons: Casual outdoor seating  -  less polished than hotel restaurants
Can get busy in the evening rush
take: Best pick if you want genuine Gilgiti/Central Asian dishes by the river rather than standard karahi. Order the trout and Mantu.

name: Cafe 1972
pros: Modern cafe ambience, popular with younger crowd
Solid BBQ and Chinese options
Inside the Mall so easy to combine with errands
cons: Mall location lacks the river/mountain view of riverfront spots
Smaller review base than the top riverfront names
take: A reliable, modern cafe-restaurant in town for BBQ and a coffee  -  good if you want indoor comfort over a riverside view.

name: Dumani (Gilgit Serena Hotel)
must_try: Local trout and the Pakistani mains; valley-view dining
pros: Among the best cooking standards in Gilgit
Excellent valley views, very clean and hygienic
Reliable for travelers wanting upscale, safe dining
cons: Serena prices are the highest in town
Breakfast buffet criticized as below 5-star standard
take: The splurge option  -  Serena's restaurant is the most polished, hygienic, view-blessed dining in Gilgit, at a price to match.

name: Mawaid
must_try: Tawa Chicken; Yak Karahi with nan
pros: Tawa chicken repeatedly singled out as the best in Gilgit
Unusual Yak Karahi for adventurous eaters
Calm ambience, ample parking, quick courteous staff
cons: Small review base so far  -  newer spot
Tucked in a market, not a scenic riverfront setting
take: Go for the tawa chicken and yak karahi  -  locals rate the food highly even if it lacks a view. A rising favorite.

name: Pizza King GB
pros: By far the most-reviewed eatery in town  -  a genuine local fast-food institution
Go-to for families and a break from desi food
Quick, consistent, kid-friendly
cons: Fast-food quality, not gourmet pizza by city standards
Busy, functional setting with no view
take: Where Gilgit goes when it wants pizza  -  not fine dining, but dependable and the local fast-food default.

name: Pakiza Hotel and Restaurant
pros: Solid no-frills desi food at budget prices
Central, easy to find on the main road
Decent karahi and BBQ for the money
cons: Basic dining room, nothing scenic
Standard menu  -  few local specialties
take: A dependable budget desi stop in the center of town for karahi and roti without fuss.

name: Paradise Hotel & Restaurant
pros: One of the most-reviewed restaurants in Gilgit  -  well established
Chicken Handi singled out by diners
Riverfront-area location
cons: Mid-3s rating  -  quality and service reported as inconsistent
Large operation can feel impersonal at peak times
take: A long-standing, high-traffic name; the Chicken Handi is the pick, but expect uneven consistency given the mixed rating.

name: Indus Hotel & Restaurant
area: Indus Market, Col Hassan Rd, Cinema Bazar
pros: Right in the bazaar  -  convenient old-city location
Honest local Pakistani cooking at low prices
Good for a quick bite while exploring Cinema Bazar
cons: Basic bazaar setting, no views
Limited menu range
take: A handy bazaar eatery for cheap, straightforward local food when you're in the old city.

name: Sivana
area: Food Street, River View Rd (Indus bank)
must_try: Shinwari-style Mutton Karahi with tandoori roti
pros: Rooftop seating right on the river bank
Shinwari mutton karahi and quick, caring service praised
Hygienic, family-friendly
cons: Reviewers say the interior/ambiance needs work  -  the river view carries it
Smaller, less-known than the top riverfront spots
take: Come for the riverside rooftop and the Shinwari mutton karahi; the setting outshines the decor.
